# W1-007 — Define accessibility and motion principles

- Phase: W1
- Status: `skipped`
- Priority: P0
- Role: accessibility
- Dependencies: none
- Parallel group: serial
- Risk: low
- Human approval required: false

## Objective

Set reduced-motion, alternative static scene, keyboard, captions and sound consent rules.

## Scope hints

- `packages/ui/README.md`
- `packages/ui/TOKENS.md`

## Deliverables

- Accessibility and motion policy.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Information never depends on animation/audio.
- [x] Reduced-motion produces meaningful static/low-motion scene.

- [x] No effects block focus, text selection or pointer interaction.

  - `evidence/W0-004-assets-ui-baseline.md`
- Commit SHA: c8041a9cf5cce526af4315dea04294aea7e2ac4a
- Reviewer decision: Existing capability verified; Accessibility and motion policy is already implemented in packages/ui/README.md, TOKENS.md, tokens.css and components.css. Existing tests verify muted-by-default audio, explicit playback, reduced motion, focus and non-interactive decorative FX; no duplicate policy layer was added.
- Residual issues: Accessibility and motion policy is already implemented in packages/ui/README.md, TOKENS.md, tokens.css and components.css. Existing tests verify muted-by-default audio, explicit playback, reduced motion, focus and non-interactive decorative FX; no duplicate policy layer was added.
